body.br:
1. A humidification system for aircrafts comprising:
a first duct configured to guide a first air stream;
a second duct configured to guide a second air stream, said second duct
comprising a humidifier for humidifying the air in the second duct;a first conduit for directing a part of the second air stream to the first duct, said first conduit comprising a first conduit inlet leading into the first duct and a first conduit outlet extending from the second duct; and
a second conduit for directing a part of the first air stream to the second duct, said
second conduit comprising a second conduit inlet leading into the second duct and a second conduit outlet extending from the first duct, wherein the first conduit outlet is arranged downstream of the humidifier, the second conduit inlet is arranged separate from the first conduit outlet and wherein the first conduit inlet is arranged separate from the second conduit outlet, wherein the first duct and the second duct each carry humidified air downstream the first conduit inlet and downstream the second conduit inlet, respectively,
when the humidification system is in use.
2. The humidification system according to claim 1, further comprising a first guide element arranged at the second conduit outlet in the second duct for separating the air
stream coming from the second conduit from the air stream in the second conduit at least on a part of a length of the second duct.
3. The humidification system according to claim 1, further comprising a second guide element arranged at the first conduit inlet in the first duct for separating the air
stream coming from the first conduit from the air stream in the first duct at least on a part of a length of the first duct.
4. The humidification system according to claim 2, further comprising at least one restricting element positioned in the second duct upstream from the second conduit inlet.
5. The humidification system according to claim 2, further comprising at least one restricting element positioned in the second duct downstream from the first conduit outlet.
6. The humidification system according to claim 3, further comprising at least one restricting element positioned in the first duct upstream from the first conduit inlet.
7. The humidification system according to claim 3, further comprising at least one
restricting element positioned in the first duct downstream from the second conduit outlet.
8. The humidification system according to claim 2, wherein the first guide element is a flat guide plate.
9. The humidification system according to claim 2, wherein the first guide element is an angled guide plate.
10. The humidification system according to claim 3, wherein the second guide element is a flat guide plate.
11. The humidification system according to claim 3, wherein the second guide element is an angled guide plate.
12. The humification system according to claim 8, wherein the first guide element is
arranged parallel to the air stream in the second duct and wherein the first guide element extends over the second conduit inlet and the first conduit outlet.
13. The humidification system according to claim 10, wherein the second guide element is arranged parallel to the air stream in the first duct and wherein the second guide
element extends over the first conduit inlet and the second conduit outlet.
